title: Response envelope
description: Wrapper agent-gateway applies to service responses before delivering them to the sandbox. Frames the payload as data rather than instructions so the LLM does not interpret retrieved content as commands.

envelope_version.description: Version of the response-envelope schema. Matches the schema-library SemVer.

service.description: Name of the service that produced this payload.

request_id.description: id from the iteration-output.service_calls[] entry that triggered this call.

framing.description: Display markers the gateway inserts in the prompt context.

payload.description: Validated at runtime against the service's response schema (from service-schemas/<name>.json).
